name: Kaka Zhang
description: Hi, I am Kaka Zhang from the Class of 2025 at BASIS Independent Silicon Valley. I qualified for AMC 10 distinguished honor roll, tiebreaked at Caltech Math Meet, and placed no.8 in Berkeley Math Tournament general round. I love competitive math and math circles, and I believe that there is a more intuitive way to learn math that is applicable to the real world, and I am dedicated to bringing an enjoyable math experience to everyone.

name: Yifan Hu
description: I'm from the Class of 2025 at BASIS Independent Silicon Valley who really finds joy in mathematics. I've qualified for the AIME, and right now, I'm studying linear algebra. Aside from math, I’m interested in physics and coding. In my free time, I enjoy playing video games or playing badminton.

name: Madeline Hu
description: Hi, I'm Madeline (Maddie) Hu from the Class of 2027 at Los Altos High School. My favorite type of math problems are proof-based problems that dive deeply into a specific study of mathematics. Particularly, I enjoy studying discrete math and geometry. I'm so excited to help others excel in their mathematical journey with Math, For Real!

name: Nicholas Wang
description: I’m Nicholas Wang, a student in the Class of 2027 at BASIS Independent Silicon Valley with a passion for coding and mathematics, particularly Number Theory. I actively participate in math competitions such as the AMC, AIME, and BMT, as well as computer science contests including USACO and various hackathons. Beyond academics, I enjoy playing the piano and cello. I am also the Co-Founder of Stellar, a nonprofit dedicated to making education intuitive, interactive, and AI-powered, accessible to everyone, completely for free.

name: Aaron Cohen
description: Hello, my name is Aaron Cohen. I am in the Class of 2027 at BASIS Independent Silicon Valley. I achieved a perfect score on the SAT, and I am currently taking Post-AP Multivariable Calculus, and seven AP courses, including AP Physics C and AP Seminar. I have been on the Distinguished Honor Roll at BASIS for every trimester since fifth grade. I am an avid reader and have read thousands of fiction and nonfiction books. I also enjoy cycling, archery, and swimming. I believe that math is best learned by focus on mastering fundamentals with incremental progress.​

name: Carolina Sun
description: Hi, my name is Carolina Sun, and I go to BISV and I'm from the Class of 2027. I enjoy math, teaching, drawing, playing chess, and so many more. I can't wait to learn with you guys!

name: Leo Zeng
description: Hi, my name is Leo Zeng, and I'm from the Class of 2027 at BASIS Independent Silicon Valley. Math is my favorite subjects, and I've developed a passion for math since kindergarten. In terms of competitive math, I've qualified for AIME since 6th grade, I've gotten perfect score in AMC 8, and I got distinguished honor roll in AMC 10. Outside of math, I also love programming, chemistry, and physics. Some of my hobbies include playing the piano, reading, and playing video games. I also have some experience of being a tutor. I hope to be able to help all of you learn to love math!

name: Benjamin Zhang
description: Benjamin Zhang is from the Class of 2027 at Lynbrook high school who loves mathematics, coding, and science. When he's not browsing random AOPS wikis, he also enjoys playing his oboe and spending time with his friends!

name: Niranjan Rao
description: Hello! I'm Niranjan, Class of 2027. I love to do and talk about math nearly all the time, don't hesitate to strike up a conversation about it. Aside from this, I also enjoy coding.

name: Julian Yang
description: I’m from the Class of 2025 at Westivew High School who loves working with math and physics. I qualified for AIME by guessing and USACO silver. Some of my hobbies are playing tennis, the violin, and Brawl Stars. (You can request to 1v1 me) I love working at a collaborative setting as multiple brains are truely bigger than one. I plan on bringing simple yet profound mathematics which will let us see how this subject lets us have greater understand of the world.

name: Sandy Xu
description: Hi! My name is Sandy Xu, and I am from the Class of 2025 at Los Altos High School. Some hobbies I have is playing piano and playing flute in marching band. I have some previous experience with competition math and I qualified for AIME in my sophomore year. I strongly believe that everyone is capable of excelling and understanding math if given the right guidance and tools, and I wish to help more people see the fun in math.

name: Naman Siddheshwar
description: Hi! I am Naman Siddheshwar, from the Class of 2027 at BASIS Independent Silicon Valley, and my favorite subjects are math, physics, computer science, and history. I believe that math is the way to understand the universe. I have participated in AMC 10 and qualified for AIME, and am in USACO Silver. Some of my passions are CS/AI, playing the piano, composing music. I find teaching to be a gratifying and enlightening experience, and I am also teaching piano to students outside of their regular classes.

name: Arnav Agrawal
description: Hi, I'm Aarnav, from the Class of 2026 at Monta Vista High School! I attended the COSMOS summer program in Discrete Math and Number Theory, am in USACO Silver, qualified for ACSL finals, and enjoy studying advanced mathematics. I am extremely passionate about CS, math, and debate!

name: Emily Wu
description: I’m Emily Wu, and I am from the Class of 2027 at Westview High School. I enjoy math and have been in the math club/math olympiad since like 3rd grade. Right now I’m only taking integrated 3 though. i’ve participated in lots of math competitions before (but never rlly won any lol) and i’d like to help out with teaching some younger students in math.

name: Ishaan Mishra
description: I'm Ishaan Mishra, from the Class of 2027 at Archbishop Mitty High School who enjoys math and spending time with my family. I have experience in many math competitions such as the AMCs, AIME, etc. I enjoy all fields of math, but I especially enjoy combinatorics and geometry. I also enjoy playing chess, biking, and hiking. I thoroughly enjoy math and eagerly anticipate sharing its wonders with younger students through teaching new concepts

name: Ardell Yu
description: Hi, my name is Ardell Yu, and I am from the Class of 2027 at LAHS. My main interests are math, art, and writing, and I’m looking forward to working with everyone!

name: Andrew Liu
description: My name is Andrew and I'm am from the Class of 2025 at BASIS Independent Silicon Valley. Beyond doing math/physics, I'm a huge fan of video games like CS2 or Roblox. You can often catch me listening to rap or watching videos on the science behind the Simpsons.

name: Jewon Shin
description: Hi I’m Jewon Shin, and I’m from the Class of 2027 at Palo Alto High School. I love solving math problems and have many experiences in math competitions. I especially like geometry and trigonometry. Aside from math, I love watching movies or F1 races! I'm so excited to teach what I love!

name: Euphenia Wu
description: Hi, I'm Euphenia (Euphie) Wu, class of 2029 at Los Altos High School. I enjoy coding, science, and math, particularly anything Algebra related. I won gold in ACSL and also participated in AMC competitions. I also enjoy swimming and hanging out with my friends. I'm excited to help cultivate a love for math in younger students through lessons in Math, For Real.

name: Walt Li
description: Hello, I'm Walt, a dedicated math enthusiast with a deep appreciation for the intricacies of numbers, equations, and problem-solving. In addition to my love for mathematics, I find joy and relaxation in playing Maimai, immersing myself in its captivating rhythm and music. These two passions of mine fuel my curiosity and creativity, shaping my journey of learning and exploration in both the mathematical and gaming realms.

name: Illia Hubenko
description: Hey, everybody! I am Illia Hubenko and I am from the Class of 2027 of Technical Lyceum NTU "KPI". Quick about me: a guy from Europe who is interested in math and everything related to it including physics and computer science, sports lover and FPS games enjoyer. Happy to be in Math, for Real✌
